data_description.dataset_name: Global Storm Surge Reconstruction (GSSR) Database - ERA-5

spatial_coverage.coverage: Daily maximum surge values at 882 tide gauges distributed along global coastlines.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Historical storm surge reconstruction from 1836 to 2015 based on ERA-5 reanalysis data.
data_description.data_type_numeric: Time series of daily maximum surge heights

property_semantics_hint.surge_reconstruction: Daily maximum surge values reconstructed from ERA-5 atmospheric reanalysis.
property_semantics_hint.tide_gauge_id: Unique identifier for each tide gauge station.
property_semantics_hint.location_name: Geographic name of the tide gauge location.
property_semantics_hint.daily_max_surge: Maximum surge height recorded for each day.
property_semantics_hint.reanalysis_source: ERA-5 atmospheric reanalysis product used for reconstruction.

data_description.important_note: The Global Storm Surge Reconstruction database was developed using data-driven models that leverage ERA-5 atmospheric reanalysis to reconstruct historical surge events at tide gauge locations worldwide. This dataset provides long-term surge records for coastal hazard assessment.

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Extract daily maximum surge values from the time series data; combine with local tide gauge observations for validation.

data_description.data_source: Tadesse, M.G., Wahl, T. via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
